recommended_main_evidence: Observed and predicted growth rate over lineage passage, faceted by 2N/4N and control/deprived; overlay observed karyotypes on predicted chromosome-state distributions.
objective_or_rank_evidence: seed10 is objective rank 1; 12 starts lie within 0.01 objective units; fit_summary.tsv reports objective_total and growth, ploidy, and flow likelihood components.
robustness_evidence: The 500-start objective table and optimizer-population diagnostic are available.
known_data_issue: Controls were fitted rather than held out and end earlier than deprived branches; the x-axis is passage rather than calendar time; local convergence code is 1, five active parameters are at bounds, DEoptim convergence flags are 0/500, and no saved Hessian/Jacobian supports confidence intervals.
interpretive_limit: Show broad in-sample fit adequacy and optimization sensitivity, not fine temporal validation, statistical confidence, or mechanistic necessity.

recommended_main_evidence: Observed-versus-predicted tumor burden plus terminal chromosome-number distributions before latent-O2 and landscape interpretation.
objective_or_rank_evidence: fit_summary.tsv reports total weighted-MAP objective 14.1193 across eight scenarios; seed25 ranks 1/500 overall, 52nd for ploidy, and 189th for burden.
robustness_evidence: convergence_summary.tsv records 500/500 DEoptim convergence flags; 29 fits are within 1% and 241 within 5% of the best total objective; multiple formal solution regions remain.
known_data_issue: necrosis_fit.tsv contains observed endpoints but all exported predicted necrosis values are NA, so necrosis cannot support a main fit-quality panel.
interpretive_limit: Good observed-predicted agreement does not identify a unique mechanism. Call seed25 the best weighted-MAP fit among starts, not a statistically confident parameter estimate.

fit_context: Joint in-vivo/in-vitro soft-coupled fits across six approved July pair winners
recommended_main_evidence: Lead with observed-versus-predicted in-vitro growth/karyotype and in-vivo burden/terminal-ploidy summaries; then use all-six sensitivity displays for ratios and functions.
objective_or_rank_evidence: The six totals span 18.8523-19.9782; stored validation verifies selected-winner provenance and objective arithmetic, not predictive validation.
robustness_evidence: Each pair has a 500-start objective distribution and reports 500/500 DEoptim convergence flags; all six local L-BFGS-B refinements were unaccepted. Across-winner bands provide solution sensitivity.
known_data_issue: Joint necrosis prediction exports are NA; current ratio and function generators operate one winner at a time and need an all-six aggregation layer.
interpretive_limit: No held-out validation, bootstrap, or posterior exists. Do not treat the lowest-objective pair as uniquely true or across-solution envelopes as confidence intervals.
